title: SpongeBob Fog Horn
blurb: Every episode opens with a blast of nautical brass, and for a whole generation that horn means the television has been successfully commandeered. As a meme it does triple duty: an alarm clock, an air-raid siren of pure nostalgia, and a way of announcing your presence with entirely unnecessary force. It is loud, unsubtle and completely unbothered about it. Play it at full volume to start the day the way Mr Krabs starts his — by smelling money somewhere in the middle distance and immediately acting on it.
origin: The nautical fog horn from SpongeBob SquarePants' iconic openings.
